metadata.description: The Claude Code Marketing Bootcamp marketplace. Two plugins: the full marketing-funnel toolkit (25 skills, incl. competitor funnel-hacking, Voice Lab, campaign planning, skyscraper research, and a supply-chain install shield) plus Browser Monkey, a two-phase browser-automation bonus for pulling analytics from no-API dashboards.

plugins.name: claude-code-marketing-bootcamp
plugins.description: The complete Claude Code Marketing Bootcamp toolkit. 25 skills that build and deploy a full marketing funnel — landing pages, lead magnets, free tools, lead research, email nurture sequences, analytics dashboards — plus competitor funnel-hacking, Voice Lab (10-skill voice training), campaign planning, skyscraper research, and a supply-chain install shield. Say what you want; Claude runs the right skill.

plugins.name: browser-monkey
plugins.description: Two-phase browser API acceleration for no-API sources. The Sniffer discovers what APIs a site actually calls; Monkey replays them at fetch() speed with your own logged-in session — no Playwright UI, no API keys. Pull analytics from dashboards that have no public API (Substack and friends) into Supabase, then save the proven workflow as a reusable slash command. The Session 6 dashboard bonus. NOT for anti-bot platforms like LinkedIn.
